seo.title: Pricing — Cadence
seo.description: 5 tiers, from Free-mium ($0) to Business ($199.99/mo): contacts and appointments, full calendar, self-service booking, custom branding. Referral program included from the Free-mium plan.
page.title: Pick the pace that fits you, simply.
page.subtitle: Start free, then upgrade as your calendar fills up. Every plan keeps Cadence simple, fast, and pleasant to use.
intro.title: 5 tiers, one rule: you pay for what you need
intro.subtitle: No card required for the {{freeLabel}} plan. Switch tiers anytime, with no commitment.

free.tagline: Perfect to organize your week and try link confirmations.

basic.tagline: A bit more room for a calendar that's starting to fill up.

standard.tagline: For those booking appointments every single week.
features: Full calendar: week & month view, one-click creation
Self-service booking via your public link

economic.tagline: For a business running at full speed all year round.
features: Everything in Standard: full calendar, booking

business.tagline: For teams and brands who want it all, with no limits.
features: Everything in {{economicLabel}}: full calendar, booking, monthly trend
Google reviews: rating, Google My Business and Maps link
